sermon.title: A Sign that Jesus Only Does What He Sees of the Father — April 18, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer looks at the man by Bethesda for 38 years whom no one could help. Jesus healed him and told him to sin no more, and religious leaders opposed it. The Father’s will is to heal sinners. Linking the pool’s waters to the peoples of Revelation, he teaches that God delivers multitudes from oppression.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: Is religion an opposing force to what God wants to do?
faqs.answer: Yes. He says religion is a very strong source and force of opposition to what God wants to do for sinners, let alone His own people.

faqs.question: Who puts Satan under whose feet?
faqs.answer: Satan isn’t putting the church under his feet; we are putting Satan under our feet through the power of Jesus Christ and His word.
